name_note: The GTDB species s__Coprococcus_A intestinihominis holds genomes that carry the NCBI names Coprococcus catus and Coprococcus intestinihominis; the literature cited here uses Coprococcus catus.

sentences.text: Coprococcus catus is described as an intestinal lactate-utilizing bacterium that converts lactate to short-chain fatty acids, including butyrate.
A genome-mining and modelling study annotated a propanediol utilization compartment in C. catus and found the butyryl-CoA:acetate CoA-transferase route dominant for butyrate formation.
In the Swedish SIMPLER cohort of 4,685 participants followed for a median 5.3 years, Coprococcus catus was among three species reported as protective for incident type 2 diabetes.

references.title: The role of lactate metabolism in shaping intestinal microbiota and health.
